entries.question: Lari department appointment
entries.answer:
To book an appointment for the Lari Cardiology department at KGMU, you must use the official online registration process, as walk-in appointments are not available.

### Booking Methods:
1.  **Online (Recommended):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select "Uttar Pradesh" as the state and "King George's Medical University" as the hospital. Follow the steps to select the Cardiology department, date, and time, and pay the ₹50 registration fee to download your slip.
2.  **ABHA/Health Care App:** You can register using your mobile number and OTP through the ABHA or Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission portal, following the same hospital selection flow.
3.  **SMS:** Send `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` to **8887019134**.
4.  **Walk-in:** If you arrive in person, you must bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number to receive an OTP. You will receive a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.

### Important Information:
*   **Referral:** If you are traveling from outside Lucknow, you must bring a valid referral letter for the Cardiology department.
*   **Timings:** The OPD ticket counter closes strictly at **1:00 PM**.
*   **Emergency:** If it is a cardiac emergency, please go directly to the Trauma Centre (Gate 14) for stabilization; patients are then transferred to the LARI Cardiology department as needed.
*   **Lari PRO Office:** For specific inquiries regarding Lari Cardiology, you may contact the PRO office at **9415099528**.

**Note:** I am not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at the KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details (such as your full name, phone number, or health records) in this chat for your safety.

entries.question: Online apoment bok karni hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein online appointment book karne ke liye aap niche diye gaye tareekon ka upyog kar sakte hain:

1. **ORS (Online Registration System):**
   - Website: [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
   - Yahan login/register karke Uttar Pradesh aur phir KGMU select karein. Department aur date chunein, patient ki details bharein aur ₹50 ka shulk (fee) online pay karke slip download kar lein.

2. **SMS ke dwara:**
   - Aap `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` likh kar **8887019134** par SMS bhej sakte hain.

3. **ABHA / Health Care App:**
   - Aap apne mobile number aur OTP ka upyog karke app dwara bhi appointment book kar sakte hain.

**Kuch mahatvapurn jankari:**
*   **OPD Slip Fee:** Sabhi booking methods ke liye ₹50 lagte hain.
*   **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se hain, to kripya department ka valid referral letter saath layein.
*   **Samay:** OPD ka samay Somwar se Shukrawar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM) hai. Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
*   **Helpline:** Kisi bhi samasya ke liye aap 0522-2258880 ya 0522-3539333 par call kar sakte hain.

*Note: Main ek AI assistant hoon, medical advice nahi de sakta. Kripya OPD mein doctor se paramarsh lein. Suraksha ke liye chat mein apni koi bhi personal jaankari (jaise Aadhaar ya phone number) share na karein.*

entries.question: Asd ka kitna paisa lagega
entries.answer:
KGMU mein ASD (Atrial Septal Defect) ke upchar ya procedure se sambandhit kharch ke liye aapko Cardiology ya CTVS vibhag ke OPD mein jaakar doctor se paramarsh lena hoga, kyunki kharch mareez ki sthiti aur zaroori procedure (jaise ki device closure ya surgery) par nirbhar karta hai.

KGMU ki official rate list ke anusar, Cardiology se sambandhit procedures ka kharch ₹80 se ₹3,600 ke beech ho sakta hai, lekin bade operations ya implants ka kharch alag hota hai.

**Aapko kya karna chahiye:**
1.  **OPD mein dikhayein:** Sabse pehle Cardiology OPD mein jaakar doctor ko dikhayein. Doctor hi sahi procedure aur uske anumanit kharch (estimate) ke bare mein bata payenge.
2.  **Rate List:** Aap vistar se jankari ke liye [KGMU Rate List](https://www.kgmu.org/rate_list2223.htm) dekh sakte hain.
3.  **Sahayata:** Agar aap arthik roop se kamzor hain, toh aap OPD mein doctor se "Ayushman Bharat" ya anya sarkari yojanaon ke bare mein pooch sakte hain jo KGMU mein manya hain.

**Salah:**
Main ek AI assistant hoon aur medical treatment ya kharch ki sahi jankari ke liye doctor ka paramarsh hi sarvopari hai. Kripya OPD slip katwayein aur doctor se milkar poori jankari lein.

*Sath hi, kripya chat mein apni ya kisi aur ki personal medical details, Aadhaar number ya phone number share na karein.*

entries.question: Kab kab opd karte hai
entries.answer:

**महत्वपूर्ण जानकारी:**
* ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। आप [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) पर जाकर अपना अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं।
* OPD पर्ची का शुल्क ₹50 है।
* पर्ची/टिकट काउंटर दोपहर 1:00 बजे (शनिवार को 12:00 बजे) ठीक बंद हो जाते हैं।
* यदि आप शहर से बाहर के मरीज हैं, तो कृपया संबंधित विभाग के लिए वैध रेफरल (Referral) साथ लाएं।

entries.question: Online booking kaise kare
entries.answer:
KGMU में ऑनलाइन अपॉइंटमेंट बुक करने के मुख्य तरीके निम्नलिखित हैं:

**1. ORS (Online Registration System) के माध्यम से:**
* सबसे पहले [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) वेबसाइट पर जाएं।
* 'Appointment' विकल्प चुनें।
* अपना राज्य (Uttar Pradesh) और फिर अस्पताल (KGMU) चुनें।
* 'New Appointment' पर क्लिक करें।
* अपना मोबाइल नंबर डालें और OTP से सत्यापित (Verify) करें।
* विभाग (Department) चुनें और उपलब्ध तारीख और समय का चयन करें।
* मरीज का विवरण भरें और ₹50 का भुगतान करें।
* भुगतान सफल होने के बाद अपनी अपॉइंटमेंट स्लिप डाउनलोड कर लें।

**2. मोबाइल ऐप (ABHA/Health Care App) के माध्यम से:**
* आप ABHA या संबंधित सरकारी हेल्थ केयर ऐप डाउनलोड कर सकते हैं।
* वहां अपना मोबाइल नंबर और OTP के जरिए रजिस्टर करें।
* ORS की तरह ही अस्पताल और विभाग का चयन करके प्रक्रिया पूरी करें।

**3. SMS के माध्यम से:**
* आप अपने मोबाइल से `APPOINTMENT <NAME>` लिखकर **8887019134** पर SMS भेज सकते हैं।

**कुछ जरूरी बातें:**
* OPD का शुल्क ₹50 है, जो आपको ऑनलाइन भुगतान करना होगा।
* यदि आप शहर से बाहर से आ रहे हैं, तो अपने साथ संबंधित विभाग का वैध रेफरल (Referral) पत्र जरूर रखें।
* अपॉइंटमेंट लेने के बाद अस्पताल आने पर अपनी स्लिप साथ लाएं। 

अधिक सहायता के लिए आप KGMU के हेल्प डेस्क नंबर **0522-2258880** या **0522-3539333** पर भी संपर्क कर सकते हैं।

entries.question: Mujhe ek marij kaa timer kaa opration karwana hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein kisi bhi prakar ki surgery ya ilaaj ke liye sabse pehle aapko OPD mein doctor ko dikhana hoga. 

Surgery kab aur kaise hogi, yeh doctor ke check-up aur medical report ke baad hi tay hota hai. Kripya neeche diye gaye steps ka palan karein:

1. **OPD Registration:** KGMU mein OPD ke liye online registration anivarya (mandatory) hai. Aap [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jakar ya ABHA/Health Care App ke madhyam se appointment book kar sakte hain. 
2. **Parchi/Token:** Agar aap walk-in aate hain, toh apna Aadhaar card aur mobile number lekar aayein. OPD slip ki fees ₹50 hai.
3. **Samay:** OPD ka samay Somwar se Shukrawar, subah 9:00 baje se dopahar 1:00 baje tak aur Shanivar ko subah 9:00 se 12:00 baje tak hai. Ravivar ko OPD band rehti hai.
4. **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne ilaaj ke liye sambhandhit vibhag (department) ka referral zarur lekar aayein.

**Zaruri Suchna:**
*   Main kisi bhi medical case ka nirdharan nahi kar sakta, isliye kripya turant apne sambhandhit vibhag ke doctor se paramarsh lein.
*   Emergency ki sthiti mein, aap seedhe **Trauma Centre (Gate 14)** ja sakte hain.
*   Apni suraksha ke liye, is chat mein marij ka koi bhi medical record, Aadhaar number ya phone number share na karein.

Aap KGMU ki helpline **0522-2258880** ya **0522-3539333** par call karke bhi adhik jankari le sakte hain.

*   Slip download karke print nikal lein.

**2. ABHA / Health Care App:**
*   App par mobile number aur OTP ke zariye register karein aur upar di gayi process follow karein.

**3. SMS dwara:**
*   Apne mobile se `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` likh kar **8887019134** par SMS bhejein.

**4. Walk-in (Hospital aakar):**
*   Aadhaar card aur active mobile number saath layein.
*   Hospital mein token lekar ₹50 ka OPD slip counter par jama karein.

**Kuch Zaroori Baatein:**
*   **OPD Samay:** Somvar se Shukravar (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) aur Shanivar (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Sunday ko OPD band rehti hai.
*   **Referral:** Agar aap Lucknow ke bahar se aa rahe hain, toh apne saath us department ka valid referral letter zaroor layein.
*   **Helpdesk:** Kisi bhi dikkat ke liye aap 0522-2258880 ya 0522-3539333 par sampark kar sakte hain.

*Note: Main ek AI assistant hoon, medical advice nahi de sakta. Kripya OPD mein doctor se paramarsh lein. Suraksha ke liye chat mein apni personal details (Aadhaar number, phone number) share na karein.*
entries.ai_question_translated_en: How to take an appointment?

entries.question: Online booking
entries.answer:
To book an appointment at KGMU, online registration is mandatory. You can use the following methods:

**1. Official Booking Portals**
*   **ORS (Online Registration System):** Visit [https://ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in). Select Uttar Pradesh, then KGMU, choose your department/date/time, enter patient details, and pay the ₹50 fee to download your slip.
*   **ABHA/Health Care App:** You can register using your mobile number and OTP, following the same hospital selection flow as the ORS portal.

**2. SMS Booking**
*   Send an SMS with the text `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.

**3. Walk-in Registration**
*   If you choose to visit in person, bring your Aadhaar card and an active mobile number. You will receive an OTP, be issued a physical token, and pay the ₹50 fee at the counter to collect your OPD slip.

**Important Information:**
*   **Fees:** A flat fee of ₹50 is charged for all booking methods.
*   **Timings:** OPD registration counters are open Monday–Friday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM and Saturday from 9:00 AM to 12:00 PM. Counters close sharply at 1:00 PM.
*   **Referrals:** Patients from outside Lucknow must carry a valid referral for the specific department they wish to visit.
*   **Recommendation:** Pre-booking via ORS or the app is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

For further assistance, you may call the KGMU helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

entries.question: Cardiology me follow up ke liye appointment kaise book karu?
entries.answer:
KGMU mein Cardiology (LARI Cardiology) mein follow-up appointment book karne ke liye aap niche diye gaye tareekon ka upyog kar sakte hain:

1. **ORS (Online Registration System):** Aap [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) par jaakar Uttar Pradesh select karein, phir KGMU chunein aur "New Appointment" par click karke Cardiology department aur date select karein.
2. **SMS dwara:** Aap apne mobile se `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhej sakte hain.
3. **Walk-in (Hospital aakar):** Aap apna Aadhaar card aur mobile number lekar hospital aayein. Token lene ke baad ₹50 ka shulk (fee) jama karke OPD slip prapt karein.
4. **Mobile App:** ABHA ya kisi bhi official Health Care app ke madhyam se bhi aap booking kar sakte hain.

**Kuch zaroori baatein:**
* Online registration/appointment lena mandatory hai.
* OPD ki timing Somvar (Monday) se Shukravar (Friday) tak subah 9:00 AM se 1:00 PM aur Shanivar (Saturday) ko subah 9:00 AM se 12:00 PM tak hoti hai.
* OPD slip counter 1:00 PM par band ho jata hai, isliye samay se pahunchein.
* Agar aap shehar se bahar ke hain, toh apna purana referral/prescription zaroor saath layein.

Kripya dhyan dein ki main ek AI hoon, medical salah nahi de sakta. Agar koi emergency ho, toh turant LARI Cardiology ke emergency vibhag se sampark karein. Suraksha ke liye chat mein apni personal details (Aadhaar number, phone number) share na karein.

entries.question: Pcpndt exam ka admit card kaha milega
entries.answer:
KGMU में PCPNDT परीक्षा या प्रवेश पत्र (admit card) से संबंधित जानकारी के लिए आप आधिकारिक वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) पर 'Examination' या 'Admission' सेक्शन देख सकते हैं।

यदि आपको अपनी विशिष्ट परीक्षा के लिए एडमिट कार्ड नहीं मिल रहा है, तो कृपया निम्नलिखित संसाधनों का उपयोग करें:

1. **परीक्षा नोटिस बोर्ड:** [https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php) पर नवीनतम अपडेट चेक करें।
2. **परीक्षा विभाग:** यदि वेबसाइट पर लिंक उपलब्ध नहीं है, तो आप KGMU के परीक्षा कार्यालय (Examination Office) से संपर्क कर सकते हैं।
3. **हेल्पलाइन:** आप KGMU के मुख्य हेल्पडेस्क नंबर **0522-2258880** पर कॉल करके सहायता प्राप्त कर सकते हैं।

कृपया स्पष्ट करें कि आप किस विशिष्ट पाठ्यक्रम या परीक्षा की बात कर रहे हैं, ताकि मैं आपको सटीक लिंक प्रदान कर सकूं।
